inventory.notes: Mixed file. (1) language-declared and timezone-declared: CreateNativeGlobalForInner takes language and zone from the declared session (GetDeclaredLanguage/GetDeclaredTimezone in StealthSessionDeclaration) instead of Top()->GetLanguageOverride()/GetTimezoneOverride(). (2) window-geometry: GetOuterSize and GetScreenXY answer declared maximized-window or popup geometry. (3) window-geometry: StealthContentOriginShift (new, about 45 lines) and IsInStealthPopup (new), used by mozInnerScreenX/Y here and by Event.cpp. Most of the 66 logic lines are in these functions; they can move wholesale to our own file. Comments are largely in Italian. The 'return {}' after the gate is kept, per its own comment. The shift function calls BrowserChild::GetDimensions in content processes.
